description: Defines interfaces and enums for cryptography operations including hashing, encryption, Diffie-Hellman key exchange, and vault management within the WPEFramework project.

classes.name: IHash
classes.description: Interface for hash calculation, supporting data ingestion and hash calculation.

classes.name: ICipher
classes.description: Interface for encryption and decryption operations.

classes.name: IDiffieHellman
classes.description: Interface for Diffie-Hellman key exchange operations.

classes.name: IPersistent
classes.description: Interface for persistent key storage management.

classes.name: IVault
classes.description: Interface for vault operations including import, export, set, get, and delete data blobs, and cryptographic key retrieval.

classes.name: ICryptography
classes.description: Main interface for cryptography services, including hash and vault access.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Static method to obtain an instance of ICryptography.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Retrieve a hash calculator for a specified hash type.

methods.name: Vault
methods.description: Retrieve a vault instance by its ID.

methods.name: Ingest
methods.description: Ingest data into hash calculator.

methods.name: Calculate
methods.description: Calculate hash from ingested data.

methods.name: Encrypt
methods.description: Encrypt data using specified IV and input.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Decrypt data using specified IV and input.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Generate Diffie-Hellman private/public keys.

methods.name: Derive
methods.description: Calculate a DH shared secret.

methods.name: Exists
methods.description: Check if a key exists in persistent storage.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Load persistent key details into vault.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Create a new key in persistent storage.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flush resources at the backend.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Return size of a vault data blob.

methods.name: Import
methods.description: Import unencrypted data blob into the vault.

methods.name: Export
methods.description: Export unencrypted data blob from the vault.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Set encrypted data blob in the vault.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieve encrypted data blob from the vault.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Delete a data blob from the vault.

methods.name: HMAC
methods.description: Retrieve an HMAC calculator.

methods.name: AES
methods.description: Retrieve an AES encryptor/decryptor.
